facts.fact: The World Bank's Burundi Digital Economy Assessment states that there is no overarching digital economy strategy beyond the ICT policy PNDTIC 2010-2025, which lacks an actionable operational plan, and recommends adopting a new overarching strategic vision; the document gives no date beyond its 2020 publication year, which is used here.

systems.system: Politique Nationale de Développement des TIC du Burundi (PNDTIC 2010-2025)
systems.owner: Ministry of Youth, Posts and ICT, with SETIC and CNSI
systems.tiers: national; 73 priorities under 10 headings, most indicators not achieved, no implementation roadmap
